title: kb_backlog returns an exit 1 with output of every command it serves as text ending (exit 1), not only held, referrers, find, check and report
goal: kb_backlog returns an exit 1 with output of every command it serves (a runs drift, a next with nothing ready, an ops or landings that cannot read the log) as text ending (exit 1), so the session reads it whole instead of a tool error cut to its last 2000 characters; an exit 2 stays a tool error; the tool description, plugin.md, tools.md and backlog.md name the rule
